tools.name: analyze
tools.title: Analyze media
tools.description: Extract segment and whole-media information together from attached files, media links, or saved media. Start here when the user asks to summarize, understand, classify, find moments, or answer a question requiring new extraction. Describe the desired fields and evidence clearly. Every extraction includes both scopes; use results or search for downstream filtering. Returns processing progress and available results or clip downloads. New processing uses credits.

files.description: Native chat attachments supplied by the host; pass descriptors unchanged. Their temporary authorized HTTPS URLs do not require public publishing. At most eight files, each at most 2 GiB.

download_url.description: Host-provided temporary authorized download URL, not a local or sandbox path. Do not invent or publicly publish a URL.

urls.description: One public HTTPS media or individual YouTube URL, or up to eight URLs. The backend imports them directly; do not download them first.

file_paths.description: Local stdio paths within configured upload roots.

destination.description: Destination for new media only. Name creates or reuses an index; omit for Playground.

processing_model.description: Model ID published by the billing pricing API.

signing_secret.description: Caller-provided verification secret; never include it in results or logs.

webhook.description: Direct integrations only. One terminal notification for this task; no account-wide subscription.

wait_seconds.description: Maximum observation time, not processing duration. Processing continues after this call ends.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and identical arguments after uncertain submission; new work uses a new key.

detail.description: Prefer summary and the complete JSON download; full is a bounded inline fallback.

terminal.description: True only when the analysis execution has ended. Media/indexing work may still be pending; results.final describes the extraction snapshot, not asset readiness.

prompt_id.description: Saved prompt used by this analysis. Available after prompt preparation; reuse it for another analysis with the same instructions.

segment_downloads.description: Direct clip downloads. All available segment links are also included in the JSON. Follow redirects without OAuth headers.

links.description: Show Open in VideoVector using the returned link for processing and completed analyses. The link opens this exact analysis; never construct app routes from IDs.

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.title: Get analysis
tools.description: Read the extracted content and progress of an existing analysis. Load these results into context for general questions about a video, unless the needed content is already available. Also retrieves partial or final output and refreshes download links. Reading results does not start another analysis; continue observing an unfinished task until it reaches a terminal state.

wait_seconds.description: Maximum observation time, not processing duration. Processing continues after this call ends.

detail.description: Prefer summary and the complete JSON download; full is a bounded inline fallback.

terminal.description: True only when the analysis execution has ended. Media/indexing work may still be pending; results.final describes the extraction snapshot, not asset readiness.

prompt_id.description: Saved prompt used by this analysis. Available after prompt preparation; reuse it for another analysis with the same instructions.

segment_downloads.description: Direct clip downloads. All available segment links are also included in the JSON. Follow redirects without OAuth headers.

links.description: Show Open in VideoVector using the returned link for processing and completed analyses. The link opens this exact analysis; never construct app routes from IDs.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search media
tools.description: Find relevant videos or scenes in a large, already-processed index or collection whose extracted content cannot fit in chat context. Query by meaning, reference image, or metadata filters within an explicit scope. Returns a limited set of matching results and continuation pages. It retrieves existing information rather than extracting new details.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and identical arguments after uncertain submission; new work uses a new key.

detail.description: Prefer summary and the complete JSON download; full is a bounded inline fallback.

tools.name: import_media
tools.title: Import media
tools.description: Transfer attached files or linked media into VideoVector for later use, without requesting extraction. Use for upload, copy, or import jobs when the user has no question about the content or explicitly wants transfer only. Can import into Playground or an index, report progress, and resume a failed transfer when the user requests recovery.

tools.name: browse
tools.title: Browse media resources
tools.description: Find saved indexes, videos, analyses, imports, or prompts in the account. Use names, identifiers, or resource-specific filters to locate an item, inspect its basic information, or choose an existing processing result. Returns resource records and paginated lists; it does not search inside extracted video content or start processing.

detail.description: Prefer summary and the complete JSON download; full is a bounded inline fallback.
